interface.title: pyXLMS web app (v1.4.5, pyXLMS 2.0.6)
interface.field: Proteomics: crosslinking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) and structural biology
interface.stage_of_work: Post-search data processing: parsing search-engine output, validating, aggregating, filtering, visualizing and converting it for downstream structural tools
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn crosslink search-engine result files into validated, aggregated crosslink lists with summary statistics, and export them in the formats used by downstream viewers and FDR tools such as xiNET, xiFDR and PyXlinkViewer.

data.note: Main run: XLpeplib_Beveridge_QEx-HFX_DSS_R1_MeroX.csv (MeroX, DSS). It gave 25 CSMs, all intra-protein Cas9 and all target-target, which aggregated to 9 crosslinks. Second run: pyxlms_custom_csm.txt (Custom, DSS). It gave 2 CSMs, 1 intra Cas9 target and 1 inter Cas10;Cas11 decoy-containing. Cas9.fasta was used for re-annotation. pyxlms_custom_xl.txt was not tried.

features.name: Result-file import with format and reagent selection
features.general: Upload one or more instrument or software output files, state which program produced them and which reagent was used, then parse them into a common table with summary counts, optionally decoding modifications
features.specific: Multi-file uploader, search-engine dropdown (Custom, MaxQuant, MaxLynx, MeroX, MS Annika, mzIdentML, pLink, Scout, ...), crosslinker dropdown (Custom, BS3, DSS, DSSO, DSBU, ADH, DSBSO, PhoX, ...), optional 'Parse modifications' switch (shows a limited-PTM-support warning), and Read file(s)!. Output is the CSM table, a Summary Statistics row, and CSV/XLSX/JSON download buttons
steps: inspect the table and summary statistics, optionally download
serves_tasks: Import a result file, telling the tool which software made it and which reagent was used
Import results written in the tool's own simple table format
Decode chemical modifications in the identifications
Save the parsed tables for later use

features.name: Reference-sequence re-annotation
features.general: Re-map identified crosslink sites onto protein positions using an uploaded reference sequence file, restricted to target matches
features.specific: Load Data tab: '(Re-)Annotate crosslink positions' switch, which reveals a FASTA uploader and a note that 'Filter for target matches only' is needed; positions are recomputed when the files are re-read
steps: turn on Filter for target matches only
compare protein positions with the un-annotated run
serves_tasks: Re-map identified sites onto a reference sequence

features.name: Target-decoy FDR validation
features.general: Estimate the false discovery rate from decoy hits and keep only identifications under a chosen threshold, at the match level and again after merging
features.specific: Validate via FDR estimation with Target FDR spinner, FDR formula ((TD+DD)/TT or (TD-DD)/TT), concatenated or separate intra/inter FDR, and higher/lower score better; plus Validate aggregated crosslinks
serves_tasks: Keep only matches that pass a false-discovery-rate threshold estimated from decoys

features.name: Multi-criteria result filter
features.general: Narrow a loaded result set by entity (protein), link category (intra/inter) and target/decoy class using multiselect chips, then apply and see updated tables and counts
features.specific: Filter tab: protein-accession multiselect, crosslink-type multiselect (Intra/Inter), target-decoy multiselect (Select all / Target-Target / Target-Decoy / Decoy-Decoy), Filter results!. 'Current' CSM and crosslink tables update with downloads
serves_tasks: Keep only links involving chosen proteins, of chosen link types and target/decoy classes

features.name: Parameterized summary plot panel
features.general: A grid of distribution plots (class counts, score histogram, category counts, top-N pairs) driven by a bin-count slider and a top-N number field
features.specific: Visualize tab: histogram-bins slider (5-100), max proteins/peptide pairs/residue pairs field, STRING organism/taxon fields (present, not used); plots for CSMs and aggregated crosslinks
serves_tasks: See summary plots of match classes, score distribution, link types, proteins and the most frequent pairs
Adjust plot resolution and how many top items are shown

features.name: Target-format exporter with requirement notes
features.general: Pick a downstream tool from a list, read what the data must satisfy for it, convert, then download the file or follow a link to the tool
features.specific: Export tab: CSM exporter (IMP-X-FDR, MS Annika, ProXL, xiFDR, xiVIEW) and crosslink exporter (AlphaLink2, IMP-X-FDR, MS Annika, PyXlinkViewer, xiNET, xiVIEW, XlinkDB, xlms-tools, ...). Each shows a requirements note, an Export to X! button, a Download in X format! button and a Go to X! link. Only the xiNET path was replayed; the xiFDR CSM path made a file from decoy-free data, which breaks its stated decoy requirement, and is unconfirmed
serves_tasks: Convert the crosslink list into a network-viewer input file
Convert match-level results into the input format of an external FDR tool

features.name: Aggregation of matches to residue-pair crosslinks
features.general: Merge repeated spectrum-level matches into unique links, grouped by a chosen key, and report how many links are intra or inter
features.specific: Load Data tab: 'Filter for unique CSMs and crosslinks' and 'Aggregate crosslink spectrum matches to crosslinks' switches; Aggregate reveals 'Group crosslinks by' (e.g. 'Protein Crosslink Position'); output is an aggregated crosslink table and its own summary counts
steps: choose the Group crosslinks by key
serves_tasks: Merge repeated observations into unique residue-pair links and count intra vs inter
